dct_description_sm:
This is a representation of the Active Heritage Applications within the City of Kingston, ON.  The P18 applications represent Heritage Permit Applications while the R01 Applications represent the Heritage Act Applications. 

For more information, please contact the Planning Building and Licensing Department at 1211 John Counter Boulevard, Phone: 613-546-4291 ext. 3180.
